desk_read: Energy markets saw strong volume at 1.6x its 20-day average for WTI Crude Oil and 1.8x its 20-day average for Brent, alongside price gains of +2.72% and +3.88% respectively, driven by short covering as total open interest fell. Gold also attracted buyers with volume at 1.5x its 20-day average and a price increase of +0.99%, accompanied by an increase in total open interest of +3.3k contracts (+0.8%) reflecting new longs. In contrast, equities experienced severe selling pressure with the Nasdaq 100 plunging -6.35% on volume at 1.4x its 20-day average while total open interest surged by +25.3k contracts (+8.7%) signaling aggressive new shorts. S&P 500 futures similarly dropped -4.37% with total open interest expanding by +49.3k contracts (+2.5%), leaving both equity markets heavily positioned.
